Happiatomin energiatasokaavio, energia-a: Energy level diagram of the oxygen atom, with the energy axis to scale. At the bottom is the ground state at an energy of 0 electronvolts. Above it is the first excited state at an energy of 1.97 electronvolts and at the top the second excited state at an energy of 4.19 electronvolts. The transitions have not been drawn.

Nine black points: (0.0025; 72), (0.0051; 130), (0.0100; 234), (0.0156; 383), (0.0278; 595), (0.0400; 768), (0.0625; 1150), (0.111; 1784) and (0.250; 3026). A straight dashed line starts from the origin and passes through the most distant point. The nearest points are clearly below the line, and the points form a curve bending downwards, not a straight line.

Nine black points: (2.0; 1.82), (3.0; 2.37), (4.0; 2.95), (5.0; 3.61), (6.0; 4.10), (8.0; 5.11), (10.0; 6.54), (14.0; 8.78) and (20.0; 11.82).
